outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 268 pregnant women with a mean age of 32.2 years who attended the Gynecology and Obstetrics inpatients unit of the University of Campania 'Luigi Vanvitelli'
finding: Antenatal depression was associated with reduced gestational age at delivery, lower APGAR scores, increased rates of labor induction and NICU admission, lower rates of breastfeeding, and higher postpartum depression scores.
